annotations.title: Analyze an address on Solana, an EVM chain, Bitcoin, Tron, dYdX or Noble

description: Analyze a wallet with Iris: on Solana (also a token mint or a program), Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain, BNB Chain, Polygon, Bitcoin, Tron, dYdX or Noble. The chain is read from the address (0x is Ethereum unless chain says another EVM chain). Costs 1 credit (2 when depth is over 1000), or without an API key $0.05 ($0.10 deep) paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. A token, or a wallet Iris hasn't read recently, can take about a minute. For a wallet: what it is (exchange, MEV bot, drainer, sniper, scam or poisoning wallet, personal wallet...), its risk score, the database's labels on it, its behaviours with example transactions, who sent it its first SOL (Solana), where its money came from and went (largest counterparties, labeled), look-alike (address poisoning) addresses, and the exchanges and mixers it moved money with, with the latest transaction for each (to use with trace_transfer). A Solana Privacy Rings user's steps there are read from the owners Rings publishes: what it deposited and for whom, whom it paid privately (amount hidden), who paid it, where its withdrawals went and whose fees it paid; a view tag alone is a lead, an anonymous policy ring is not traceable. For a token mint: its creator and the creator's funder, the launch bundle and who funded it, red flags, the wallets in its groups and its top holders. For a program: who can upgrade it, who deployed it, its top callers. Only the latest transactions (depth) are read. Returns a summary and a link to the full view on iriscan.app.

address.description: The address: Solana or Tron base58, 0x (EVM), Bitcoin (bc1, 1 or 3), dydx1 or noble1. On Solana also a token mint or a program.

chain.description: The chain, when the address's form doesn't say it: an EVM chain for a 0x address (ethereum by default). Read from the address otherwise.

depth.description: How many of the most recent transactions to read. Over 1000 is a deep analysis (2 credits, or $0.10 with x402). Smaller is faster: 200 is often enough for a first look.
